item.text: [{"task_id":"68bc2e87","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    strength = float(params['rule'][1])","    threshold = float(params['rule'][2])","    colours = [int(c) for c in np.unique(grid) if int(c) != background]","    masks = []","    rows = np.arange(grid.shape[0]).reshape((-1, 1))","    cols = np.arange(grid.shape[1]).reshape((1, -1))","    for colour in colours:","        points = np.argwhere(grid == colour)","        low = np.min(points, axis=0)","        high = np.max(points, axis=0)","        inside = (rows >= low[0]) & (rows <= high[0]) & (cols >= low[1]) & (cols <= high[1])","        border = (rows == low[0]) | (rows == high[0]) | (cols == low[1]) | (cols == high[1])","        masks.append(inside & border)","    edges = np.zeros((len(colours), len(colours)))","    for a in range(len(colours)):","        for b in range(len(colours)):","            if a != b:","                overlap = masks[a] & masks[b]","                evidence = np.count_nonzero(overlap & (grid == colours[b]))","                if strength * evidence > threshold:","                    edges[a, b] = strength","    remaining = list(range(len(colours)))","    ordered = []","    while remaining:","        chosen = remaining[0]","        for candidate in remaining:","            blocked = False","            for predecessor in remaining:","                if edges[predecessor, candidate] > threshold:","                    blocked = True","                    break","            if not blocked:","                chosen = candidate","                break","        ordered.append(colours[chosen])","        remaining.remove(chosen)","    return np.array(ordered, dtype=int).reshape((-1, 1))"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[8,1,0.5]},"rationale":"Recover each coloured rectangle's perimeter from its bounding box. At perimeter intersections, the visible colour establishes which rectangle lies above the other. Topologically order these relations from bottom to top and return the colours in one column."}]
